msg: The gnomes both have different style hats one will wear a pointy mushroo  hat and the other a flat mushroom hat. Seect one of the hats to begin, I found that if I selected for example the pointy hat and it was a high number then the hat would give high numbers and then start dropping down so for example the pattern will be 8,7,7,6,5,3,2Whe I got to 2 I would switch over to the other hat (flat) and the pattern would be the same I would continue doing this and then switch again to the other hat.Keep alternating the hats once you reach a low number
